subject.title: fix(plugins): bound marketplace manifest file reads

question: Should marketplace manifests adopt the shared regular-file-only boundary despite breaking existing symlinked manifest paths?
rationale: The patch correctly fixes unbounded allocation, but the selected helper also changes the accepted local marketplace input contract across listing and installation.

options.title: Adopt regular-file-only
options.body: Accept the limited compatibility impact to keep manifest reads bounded and prevent cloned manifests from redirecting outside their marketplace root.

options.title: Preserve contained symlinks
options.body: Pause merge and implement a bounded policy that follows symlinks only when the resolved target remains within the marketplace root.

recommendation.title: Adopt regular-file-only
recommendation.body: Accept the limited compatibility impact to keep manifest reads bounded and prevent cloned manifests from redirecting outside their marketplace root.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and owned the marketplace registry feature and are the strongest history-based owner for its permanent manifest contract.
